opportunities.title: Junior Scientist Conference Grant

deadlines.raw: 1st October 2026 (bi-monthly; 1st day of February, April, June, August, October and December)

amount.raw: Scheme A up to £200; Scheme B up to £500 (£750 for Adelphi Genetics Forum co-sponsored awards); Scheme C up to £300

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Genetics Society 'junior scientist' members. Scheme A: undergraduate, Master's and PhD students and postdocs within six years of PhD viva. Schemes B & C: PhD students and postdocs within six years of PhD viva. B & C open to UK-based members attending conferences outside the UK and non-UK members attending UK conferences.
opportunities.summary: Supports attendance of Genetics Society junior scientist members at genetics conferences: (A) Genetics Society/SIG meetings, (B) non-Genetics Society meetings, (C) virtual conferences. Recipients must present a poster or give a talk.

opportunities.title: Training Grant

deadlines.raw: 15th November 2026 (quarterly; 15th February, May, August and November)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: All members of the Genetics Society studying or working in the UK, or attending a course held in the UK. Students can apply as soon as they become members; others should be members for at least one year.
opportunities.summary: Grants to enable members to attend formal short training courses in genetics, or a collaborative visit to another laboratory to train in specific genetic/genomic techniques.

opportunities.title: Heredity Fieldwork Grant

deadlines.raw: 1st November 2026 (quarterly; 1st February, May, August and November)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: All members of the Genetics Society studying or working in the UK, or intending to carry out fieldwork in the UK. Students can apply as soon as they become members; others should be members for at least one year.
opportunities.summary: Covers travel and accommodation costs associated with a field-based genetic research project; research should produce results suitable for publication in the journal Heredity. Funded by income from Heredity.

opportunities.title: Public Engagement Grant

deadlines.raw: 1st October 2026 (two deadlines per year: 1st March and 1st October)

opportunities.summary: Supports public engagement activities related to genetics, delivered in person or virtually, covering eligible travel and materials costs (UK-based travel only).

opportunities.title: Carer's Award
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Any Genetics Society member with caring responsibilities, regardless of age of the person cared for. Priority given to early-career scientists and according to need.
opportunities.summary: Award to support members with caring responsibilities to attend Genetics Society meetings and events; applied for prior to the event and claimed in arrears on production of receipts.

opportunities.title: One-off Meeting Sponsorship

amount.raw: Several levels: a Genetics Society lecture for a few hundred pounds, a session up to about £1,000, major sponsorship of an entire meeting typically £1,000-£2,000 or potentially several thousand pounds

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Genetics Society members organising genetic-themed meetings based in, or with strong links to, the UK.
opportunities.summary: Sponsorship of one-off genetic-themed meetings not organised directly by the Genetics Society, towards the organisation of the meeting (not attendance), including a Carer's Award component.

opportunities.title: Special Interest Group (SIG) Funding
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Genetics research communities wishing to run regular series of meetings based in, or with strong links to, the UK.
opportunities.summary: Sponsorship of regular series of research meetings on particular themes for genetics research communities (Special Interest Groups), submitted at least three months before the first meeting.
